config.label: Access token for inite
config.description: Access token for inite.ai. Optional: three checks run locally without one. Run `npx @inite/visibility login` to add the full audit.

config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. Without it every open tool answers, under per-address allowances, and the audit runs as the survey. Bearer <access_token> adds my_reports, your audits behind visibility_fixes and visibility_history, and the account's tier; a member tool called without one answers 401 with WWW-Authenticate pointing at https://inite.ai/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/api/mcp/analyzer, which names auth.inite.ai.
